items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: and I did get a wire that she was in town, and that's how I got married.

ctx.x: But anyway, when I came back through, I stopped at my girlfriend's house and I told her I was going to, you know, we were going on the way to her home. To open a theatre there. And so it was the oddest proposal, I guess; I said, "If you come to Kansas City, I'll marry you." Because that was her home, you know.

And we drove -- drove all across country to get to Kansas City to get there and so we got there and opened at the theatre, and I did get a wire that she was in town, and that's how I got married. Now, when I married her, I quit, and I only stayed with them for that week; I must have stayed with them for 3 weeks; 2 weeks up in San Francisco and then one week at the theatre in Kansas City, but the reason it wasn't as bad as it sounds, the other drummer stayed with us but all he was doing was sitting in the wings,…
